title: SysAid Review (2026)
intro: SysAid is evaluated here as an IT service management (ITSM) / employee service desk platform — SysAid is an ITSM and employee service-desk platform (incidents, requests, assets, automation) for internal IT. The first-party pricing page is quote-led; 2026 listings commonly cite Professional around $89/agent/month — treat as medium-confidence, not a self-serve tile with Freshservice’s certainty. Enterprise is custom with a published 20-agent minimum. Free trial. Same itsm-service-desk cluster as ServiceNow and Freshservice — this entity does not outrank ServiceNow 8.7 or Freshservice 8.4. Distinct from HaloITSM’s all-in-one UK calculator and from ManageEngine’s $13 Standard floor. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s IT & Development methodology (ease of use, IT job fit, workflow depth, integrations, admin/security, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose SysAid when a quoted ITSM desk with automation/AI assist is the job — not Freshservice’s published Starter by default, and not ServiceNow.
verdict: Choose SysAid when a quoted ITSM desk with automation/AI assist is the job — not Freshservice’s published Starter by default, and not ServiceNow. Compare ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus for a $13 published floor; Freshservice for the mid-market award path; HaloITSM for all-in-one UK calculator packaging. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-18 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, host/GB rates and minimums on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Service-desk UX is approachable for internal IT; quote-led buying is the friction versus ManageEngine’s published $13. Not a lab test.
ITSM cluster peer of Freshservice/HaloITSM — not an observability or git product.
Incidents, requests, assets, and automation cover a solid desk loop; below ServiceNow ITIL/CMDB ceiling.
Slack/Teams/API cover typical IT ops; thinner public marketplace than Atlassian.
Paid/Enterprise admin is adequate for mid-market desks; not Now Platform governance.
Enterprise min 20 agents plus custom quote; held at 7 versus ServiceNow scale.
~$89 Professional is a weaker published story than ManageEngine $13 or Freshservice $19 — medium confidence on the sticker. Affiliate economics excluded.
SysAid Copilot-style ITSM assist is a real path — scored as assistance, not an award reason versus Freshservice.
